approvers: Managing director, main contractor site manager, procurement for supplier approval
reason: We pay suppliers at 60 to 90 days, not 50% deposits up front, and at about 19 euro per m2 this costs many times what film and tape cost us. We do not buy this today and a new supplier means documents, insurance and a credit application for a line we have no budget for.
objection: Nineteen euro per m2 plus a deposit against cheap film and tape that is good enough, and I would also worry about a sprayed coating on coated glass and frames, with a risk of marking or residue when it is peeled off.
instead: Keep using protection film and tape on glazing and frames, bought cheaply from the local supplier on normal credit terms.
would_change_my_mind: A price near film and tape cost, 60 day terms with no deposit, and written proof from a glazing contractor that it peels clean off coated glass and finishes without marking.
